rule: Photographing government buildings, military installations, and border areas is strictly prohibited and can lead to detention by authorities.
penalty: Confiscation of equipment, fines, and possible detention for questioning.

rule: Drinking alcohol in public places (parks, streets, playgrounds) is an administrative offense. Alcohol should only be consumed in licensed bars and restaurants.
penalty: Fine of approximately 5-10 MRP (Monthly Residential Project - standard fine unit in Kazakhstan).

rule: Foreigners are required to carry their passport and registration documents at all times. Police have the right to stop and check identity documents.
penalty: Fine or detention until identity is verified.

rule: When visiting mosques, dress modestly. Women should cover their heads and men should not wear shorts. Remove shoes before entering.
penalty: Refusal of entry or request to leave.

rule: Drones with a weight over 250g must be registered. Flying in Astana center without a special permit is strictly forbidden due to proximity to government buildings.
penalty: Fine and confiscation of the drone.
